advancements.arkofcosmos.fly_swatter.des: Kill a fly with the Ark of the Cosmos
tooltip.arkofcosmos.old_one_attack:
Fires different homing projectiles based on what biome you're in
Upon hitting an enemy you are granted a buff based on what biome you're in
The physical culmination of your journey, capable of rending gods asunder
Empowered by the might of the Fourth Calamity, it has reclaimed the strength lost to the annals of history.
tooltip.arkofcosmos.controls:
<left> to perform a 5-swing combo that ends by throwing the blade
The thrown blade will follow your cursor
Releasing while the blade is out will cause an exploding snap
tooltip.arkofcosmos.parry:
<right> to snip out the scissor blades in front of you
Hitting an enemy with it will parry them
Parry can granting you brief invulnerability
Parrying anything will empower the next 16 swings of the sword
tooltip.arkofcosmos.blast:
With empowered charges, hold %1$s and press %2$s to provoke a Big Rip in spacetime, consuming all charges
If at least 5 charges were consumed, keep holding %1$s and %2$s until after the snap to dash toward the scissors
tooltip.arkofcosmos.flavor: The physical culmination of your journey, capable of rending gods asunder
galaxia.description.0:
Swing Galaxia around you, accelerating over time and emitting homing
cosmic bolts
Release when charged to hurl Galaxia toward your crosshair alongside six
gigantic cosmic bolts
galaxia.controls: Hold %1$s to attack; release to unleash a charged attack
galaxia.description.2:
Channel a vortex of galactic energies that grows stronger over time and
on enemy hits
Release when charged to fire the star forward; immediately attack toward
it again to dash to it and release cosmic bolts
galaxia.select: Choose an attunement; release %1$s to confirm
galaxia.description.3:
Charge a god-erasing lunge, emitting cosmic bolts as you charge; release
to unleash it
Terrain impact causes a shockwave and a storm of cosmic energies
spreading across the surface
galaxia.description.1:
Throw Galaxia toward your crosshair, tethered by constellations
The spinning blade follows your aim; hits cause nebulous explosions that
spawn homing cosmic bolts
galaxia.flavor:
Freed from earthly shackles and coursing with cosmic power
Has access to all attunements at all times
galaxia.passive.0:
Capricorn's Blessing: periodically releases weakening stars around your
crosshair while attacking
The ring initially moves away from you, slowing over time
galaxia.passive.1:
Cancer's Blessing: periodically releases lifestealing stars around you
while attacking
The ring initially moves toward you, slowing over time
galaxia.selection_controls:
Hold %1$s to open the selector
Move the cursor to an attunement; release to confirm
elements.combo: Hold %s to perform a 5-swing combo that ends by throwing the blade
elements.snap: Release at the right moment while the blade is out to snap shut and deal extra damage
elements.parry: %s to snip out the scissor blades in front of you and gain brief invulnerability
elements.parry_window: Hit an enemy or take an attack within 0.25 seconds of activation to parry
elements.empower: Parrying empowers the next 10 swings of the sword, letting you use both blades at once
elements.blast: With empowered charges, hold %s and press %s to provoke a Big Rip in spacetime and use all charges
elements.flavor: A heavenly pair of blades infused with the essence of §kTerraria§r, powerful enough to cut through the fabric of reality
entity.arkofcosmos.mahou_tsukai.phase_2: God of the End   EverlaPrismer Aya
dialogue.arkofcosmos.mahou.first_end: Strange. You should be dead by now...
dialogue.arkofcosmos.mahou.second_rain: It has not been long since you barely defeated the Wither. That thing was a failure, was it not?
dialogue.arkofcosmos.mahou.phase_two_hal: You wield tremendous power, yet use it only for your own selfish desires.
dialogue.arkofcosmos.mahou.escape: Do not try to run. As long as you live, pain will never leave you.
dialogue.arkofcosmos.mahou.summon: A newcomer who knows only killing and stealing, yet gains power through it. Who does that remind me of...?
dialogue.arkofcosmos.mahou.summon_dead: The outcome of this battle means nothing to you! Then what reason do you have to interfere?
dialogue.arkofcosmos.mahou.low_quarter_2: If I fail here, I have no future.
dialogue.arkofcosmos.mahou.low_quarter_3: Once you defeat me, only one path remains.
dialogue.arkofcosmos.mahou.low_quarter_4: And that path... has no future either.
dialogue.arkofcosmos.mahou.defeat_2: You do not seem to be that fourth calamity...
dialogue.arkofcosmos.mahou.defeat_3: Then, to apologize for mistaking you for someone else, take this.
dialogue.arkofcosmos.mahou.defeat_4: I took this from that one. It should be useful to you.
dialogue.arkofcosmos.mahou.first_rain_re: If you want to feel a democratic elbow, you found the right person.
dialogue.arkofcosmos.mahou.first_end_rep: If your soul is scattered one day, would you mind if I worked it into my spell?
dialogue.arkofcosmos.mahou.second_rain_r: You are still far from victory.
dialogue.arkofcosmos.mahou.third_rain_re: It has been a long time since I tested my magic on such an interesting target dummy.
dialogue.arkofcosmos.mahou.vortex_repeat: I wonder whether you have seen these in nightmares since our first encounter.
dialogue.arkofcosmos.mahou.summon_repeat: Only an empty shell in the form of a Guardian; perhaps some fragment of its soul remains.
dialogue.arkofcosmos.mahou.defeat_1_repe: An impressive performance. I acknowledge your victory.
dialogue.arkofcosmos.mahou.defeat_2_repe: Without a doubt, you will meet enemies far stronger than me.
dialogue.arkofcosmos.mahou.defeat_3_repe: I believe you will not make the same mistake she did.
dialogue.arkofcosmos.mahou.defeat_4_repe: I look forward to seeing what becomes of your future.
dialogue.arkofcosmos.mahou.low_quarter_r: At least your technique has not declined.
boss.arkofcosmos.the_player: 'I’m Angry When I‘m Angry', Kira Official
